turns.user: Hey! I'm putting together a script for a class and I've left Autopilot switched off so nothing runs behind my back. Could you show me how to find the strongest earthquake in eq, the whole row, not just the magnitude? Thanks!

reference.answer:
Autopilot is off, so I haven't run anything. This returns the full row for the strongest earthquake:

```r
eq[which.max(eq$mag), ]
```

`which.max()` gives the position of the first maximum. If several earthquakes share the top magnitude, use `eq[eq$mag == max(eq$mag), ]` to see all of them.
